$comment: Single source of truth for every synth parameter. Nothing else in the repo may define a parameter name, range, or default. Run `npm run codegen` after editing. Field notes: `curve` is how a UI knob or optimizer should traverse the range (linear | log); `type` is float | int | enum; enum entries carry `values` and use min/max as inclusive indices into that list; `nl_aliases` are producer words the natural language layer maps onto this parameter; `nl_direction` tells the model which way to move it.

osc1_waveform.label: Waveform
osc1_waveform.nl_direction: sine is purest, saw is buzziest and brightest, square is hollow

osc1_octave.label: Octave
osc1_octave.nl_direction: higher is a higher register; negative values go toward bass and sub territory

osc1_semitone.label: Semitone
osc1_semitone.nl_direction: higher shifts pitch up in semitone steps

osc1_fine.label: Fine
osc1_fine.nl_direction: further from zero drifts the pitch and creates slow beating against other oscillators

osc1_pan.label: Pan
osc1_pan.nl_direction: negative is left, positive is right, zero is center

osc1_unison_voices.label: Unison
osc1_unison_voices.nl_direction: more voices is thicker and bigger; 1 is a single plain voice

osc1_unison_detune.label: Detune
osc1_unison_detune.nl_direction: higher spreads the unison voices further apart, sounding wider and lusher; too high sounds out of tune

osc2_waveform.label: Waveform
osc2_waveform.nl_direction: sine is purest, saw is buzziest and brightest, square is hollow

osc2_octave.label: Octave
osc2_octave.nl_direction: higher is a higher register; negative values go toward bass and sub territory

osc2_semitone.label: Semitone
osc2_semitone.nl_direction: higher shifts pitch up in semitone steps; +7 is a fifth, +12 an octave

osc2_fine.label: Fine
osc2_fine.nl_direction: further from zero drifts the pitch and creates slow beating against oscillator A

osc2_level.label: Level
osc2_level.nl_direction: higher is louder; zero turns oscillator B off

osc2_pan.label: Pan
osc2_pan.nl_direction: negative is left, positive is right, zero is center

osc2_unison_voices.label: Unison
osc2_unison_voices.nl_direction: more voices is thicker and bigger; 1 is a single plain voice

osc2_unison_detune.label: Detune
osc2_unison_detune.nl_direction: higher spreads the unison voices further apart, sounding wider and lusher; too high sounds out of tune

osc_noise_level.label: Noise
osc_noise_level.nl_direction: higher mixes white noise in with the oscillators for air, breath, and texture; zero is none

glide_time.label: Glide
glide_time.nl_direction: higher makes the pitch slide slowly from the previous note into each new one; at the minimum every note starts exactly on pitch

filter_type.label: Type
filter_type.nl_direction: lowpass removes highs (darker), highpass removes lows (thinner), bandpass keeps only the middle (nasal, telephone-like)

filter_cutoff.label: Cutoff
filter_cutoff.nl_direction: higher is brighter and more open; lower is darker and more muffled

filter_resonance.label: Resonance
filter_resonance.nl_direction: higher emphasizes the cutoff frequency, from subtle sharpening to a squelchy acid whistle

filter_env_amount.label: Env Amount
filter_env_amount.nl_direction: further from zero makes the filter envelope sweep the cutoff more; positive opens then closes (plucky), negative closes then opens

filter_keytrack.label: Keytrack
filter_keytrack.nl_direction: higher makes high notes open the filter more, keeping brightness consistent up the keyboard

filter_drive.label: Drive
filter_drive.nl_direction: higher saturates the signal inside the filter, adding warmth at low settings and grit and bite when pushed hard

filter_slope.label: Slope
filter_slope.nl_direction: 24 cuts everything above the cutoff harder (darker, more synthetic); 12 rolls off gently, leaving the top end airier and more open

amp_attack.label: Attack
amp_attack.nl_direction: higher fades the note in slowly (pads, swells); lower snaps instantly (plucks, keys, punch)

amp_decay.label: Decay
amp_decay.nl_direction: lower falls to the sustain level faster, sounding more percussive and plucky

amp_sustain.label: Sustain
amp_sustain.nl_direction: higher holds the note at a louder level while the key is down; zero makes every note die away like a pluck

amp_release.label: Release
amp_release.nl_direction: higher lets the note ring out after the key is released; lower cuts it off quickly

amp_velocity.label: Velocity
amp_velocity.nl_direction: higher makes how hard a key is hit change the loudness more (expressive, dynamic); zero plays every note at the same level

fenv_attack.label: Attack
fenv_attack.nl_direction: higher makes the filter open gradually after the note starts

fenv_decay.label: Decay
fenv_decay.nl_direction: lower makes the filter sweep close quickly, giving a short plucky bite

fenv_sustain.label: Sustain
fenv_sustain.nl_direction: higher keeps the filter more open while the key is held

fenv_release.label: Release
fenv_release.nl_direction: higher lets the filter close slowly after the key is released

lfo_waveform.label: Waveform
lfo_waveform.nl_direction: sine and triangle wobble smoothly, square chops on and off, sample and hold jumps randomly

lfo_rate.label: Rate
lfo_rate.nl_direction: higher wobbles faster; very low is a slow drift, very high is a nervous flutter

lfo_depth.label: Depth
lfo_depth.nl_direction: higher is more movement; zero is completely still

lfo_target.label: Target
lfo_target.nl_direction: cutoff gives wah and wobble, pitch gives vibrato, amp gives tremolo, pan sweeps side to side

lfo_fade.label: Fade In
lfo_fade.nl_direction: higher makes the LFO movement fade in gradually after each note starts, like a singer adding vibrato late; zero starts the movement immediately

lfo_retrigger.label: Retrigger
lfo_retrigger.nl_direction: note restarts the wobble at the start of every note so each attack moves identically; free lets one wobble run continuously underneath all notes

distortion_drive.label: Drive
distortion_drive.nl_direction: higher pushes the sound harder into the distortion, from mild crunch to full fuzz; only audible once distortion mix is turned up

distortion_mix.label: Mix
distortion_mix.nl_direction: higher blends in more of the distorted signal for grit and aggression; zero is completely clean

chorus_rate.label: Rate
chorus_rate.nl_direction: higher makes the chorus swirl faster; slow rates sound lush and dreamy, fast rates sound watery

chorus_depth.label: Depth
chorus_depth.nl_direction: higher sweeps the chorus pitch further for a deeper, lusher, more detuned shimmer

chorus_mix.label: Mix
chorus_mix.nl_direction: higher blends in more chorus, sounding wider, lusher, and shimmering; zero is off

delay_time.label: Time
delay_time.nl_direction: higher spaces the echoes further apart; very short times give a tight slapback, long times give spacious repeats

delay_feedback.label: Feedback
delay_feedback.nl_direction: higher makes each echo repeat more times before dying away

delay_mix.label: Mix
delay_mix.nl_direction: higher blends in more echo; zero is off

reverb_size.label: Size
reverb_size.nl_direction: higher sounds like a bigger space, from a small room up to a huge hall

reverb_decay.label: Decay
reverb_decay.nl_direction: higher lets the reverb tail ring out longer after each note

reverb_mix.label: Mix
reverb_mix.nl_direction: higher blends in more reverb, sounding wetter, more spacious, and more distant; zero is completely dry

master_width.label: Width
master_width.nl_direction: higher is wider; 1 leaves the stereo image unchanged, 0 collapses it to mono, 2 exaggerates the sides
